title: Why Fear Disappears at Height
description: An immersive fantasy explainer where the viewer experiences how height changes fear.

scenes.visual_prompt: first person point of view, slowly rising above thick clouds, endless sky opening ahead, soft golden sunlight, fantasy cinematic lighting, volumetric fog, dreamlike unreal environment, immersive scale, no text, no watermark
scenes.motion_prompt: slow vertical ascent as if floating upward, extremely smooth motion
scenes.narration: You feel it... As you rise... something inside you goes quiet.

scenes.visual_prompt: first person view looking down from extreme height, tiny world far below, clouds drifting past, massive open sky, fantasy cinematic atmosphere, strong sense of distance and scale
scenes.motion_prompt: gentle forward drift with slight downward tilt, calm motion
scenes.narration: The noise fades... The worries shrink... Everything feels far away.

scenes.visual_prompt: first person sensation of gliding through open sky, vast horizon in all directions, glowing clouds, surreal fantasy lighting, feeling of freedom and expansion, unreal style
scenes.motion_prompt: slow forward glide through open space, wings-free floating motion
scenes.narration: Fear survives on closeness... on details... on tight spaces.

scenes.visual_prompt: first person view surrounded by open sky and warm light, clouds parting gently, symbolic clarity and calm, fantasy cinematic environment
scenes.motion_prompt: very slow upward drift, clouds separating smoothly
scenes.narration: Up here... your mind stops zooming in... and starts seeing everything at once.
